focusedRun.note: Includes four real-DOM delayed-focus regressions after adding the current-station panel guard. Included in the final suite, not counted twice.

initialFocusedRun.note: Before the final delayed-focus station guard and four associated cases.

review: Read-only review identified the reused-panel delayed-focus edge case; the added station guard addresses it. Final review found no remaining blocker.

recoveries.description: WebGL shader/context errors and a canvas timeout during rapid repeated remounts. The host later reported only 185 MiB free of 15981 MiB physical memory. Independent scenarios now use one fresh Chromium process at a time and verify a real live WebGL canvas; all console and page errors remain observable.

All station groups completed without WebGL/page errors; the phone screenshot failed because document coordinates exceeded viewport-only bounds. The compact crop now uses full-page bounds. The complete final browser run passed after this harness-only correction.
Windows rejected a direct public-mirror overwrite because a user-mapped section was open. Same-directory temporary write and atomic rename succeeded; byte parity and final hashes were rechecked.

observations: Final focused and 16-file regression runs passed.
Existing React key warnings in siege and compare view rendering; tests pass.
Production source remained unchanged throughout the browser recovery runs.
limits: One latest accepted design Apply checkpoint per station; consuming it does not create redo or older history.
Undo requires the complete current physical station setup to match the applied snapshot; constraints, saved records and writing are preserved.
No full application build, physical assistive-technology session or performance benchmark.
